BrochureContent.Content:
Set on approximately 5 acres of mature grounds on the ever-popular Fairyhouse Road, this spacious 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom bungalow offers a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial family home with land in one of Meath's most sought-after locations.

While the property would benefit from modernisation throughout, it presents a fantastic canvas for a new owner to create their dream home. The bright, well-proportioned rooms are flooded with natural light, and the layout offers real potential to extend, reconfigure, or simply refresh to suit contemporary living.

Outside, the real magic of this property reveals itself. The beautifully established garden provides a wonderful backdrop for outdoor living, while the surrounding acreage offers exceptional scope — whether for equestrian use, hobby farming, additional development (subject to planning), or simply enjoying the space and privacy that comes with owning your own land.

A detached garage adds further versatility, ideal for storage as is, or ready to be transformed into a home office, studio, gym, or workshop, subject to the usual permissions.

Positioned in the heart of Ratoath and within easy reach of local schools, shops, and amenities, with excellent access to the M3 for Dublin commuters, this is a superb opportunity for those seeking space, potential, and a genuine slice of the countryside without compromising on location.

In brief:
•4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms
•Internal area c. 151.66m2
•Approx. 5 acres of land
•Requires updating — huge potential
•Bright, spacious rooms throughout
•Mature, beautiful gardens
•Detached garage — flexible use
•Sought-after Fairyhouse Road location
